string.text: Nudges the angle/height up and down. Only does anything in keybind mode.
Turns dynamic lean control on or off. The normal lean key still works like vanilla either way.
How you control the dynamic lean. Either with mouse movement or dedicated keybinds.
How much moving the mouse actually leans you. Putting the slider back in the middel is the default value.
How much a keypress actually leans you. Putting the slider back in the middel is the default value.
Lean affects Liz Inertia Anim Power
Scales the Liz Inertia lean animation with how far you're actually leaning instead of always full strength.
Hold with the adjustment key to lean further left.
Hold with the adjustment key to lean further right.

Lets you dynamicly switch sides when leaning instead of stopping in the middle. Now you can easily move your lean from left to right or from right to left. You could even go left, right, left and right again.
Makes the normal lean key obsolete. Now you can just use the adjustment key and start leaning from nothing.
Turns dynamic crouch control on or off. The normal crouch key still works like vanilla either way.
How you control the dynamic lean. Either with mouse movement or dedicated keybinds.
How much moving the mouse actually changes the height. Putting the slider back in the middel is the default value.
How much a keypress actually changes height. Putting the slider back in the middel is the default value.
Hold with the adjustment key to go up.
Hold with the adjustment key to go down.
Dynamicly switches stances when reaching certain height. Meaning it automaticly makes you crouche, stands you up or lets you go prone.
Makes the normal crouch key obsolete. Now you can just use the adjustment key and start crouching from nothing.

Created so you dont easily get pulled out or in stances. There is now "weight" needed to pull you out or in a stance. Going prone is deliberately harder to trigger than standing back up. This slider scales both together, keeping that balance.

Master on/off switch. Turning it off stands you up straight and drops any lean first, so it's the safe way to disable the mod. Do this before removing the mod, otherwise you could get stuck mid-crouch.
When trying to sprint you are no longer held back by a lean or by a crouch. Your character will automaticly stand up straight and break the lean so you can easily sprint out of stressfull situations.

How long a released lean or crouch stays remembered before it resets to normal. Re-engage within this window and you pick up right where you left off; wait longer and it starts fresh like vanilla. Set to zero to remember forever.
This key needs to be held down together with the mouse or keybind to start leaning or crouching. Default is LEFT-ALT.
